about: Weyburn is a city in southeastern Saskatchewan on the Souris River, southeast of Regina along Highway 39. Oilfield services, agriculture, and a role as a regional hub for the southeast prairie define the community. About 11,000 people live in Weyburn.
seoSummary: Southeastern Saskatchewan city on the Souris River—oilfield and farm hub southeast of Regina on Highway 39.
knownFor: Service centre for surrounding farm country
